author: Danielle Ruddy
title: Beaufort nonprofit brings multiple organizations under one roof to better serve community - NewsBreak
text:
By Danielle Ruddy ,
4 hours ago
BEAUFORT, S.C. (WSAV) —Lowcountry Outreach began operations in 2023 to bring together key free services for those in need.
About 15 percent of Beaufort County residents lack reliable transportation which is one of the many gaps that Lowcountry Outreach is working to fill.
The nonprofit offers an Angel Rides program in partnership with Good Neighbor Medical Clinic to provide free transportation to medical appointments for patients who do not have reliable transportation.
Lisa Daly, Lowcountry Outreach director, told WSAV the program has already made an impact in the community.
“We provide free transportation to patients’ medical appointments,” said Daly. “It could be an appointment in Bluffton. We’ve gone to Walterboro. We’ve gone to Charleston with their patients. And we really would like to expand.”
Lowcountry Outreach also houses several nonprofits connecting residents with services ranging from legal assistance to support for older adults and their caregivers.
